case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client context, clear cost-reduction objective, $780K quantified savings, and multiple documented proof points are all available.
case_study_packaging.headline: PE-backed women’s health platform secures $780K in annual savings and 3.4x ROI through Treya’s fast-track strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Advantia Health’s 50 OB/GYN clinics and tele-health operations were buying independently across two legacy payment systems, leaving $19 million of supplier spend fragmented, overpriced and largely unmanaged. With BlueMountain Capital expecting rapid EBITDA expansion, Advantia needed immediate cost relief and basic procurement discipline—but lacked the internal resources, data and leverage to act on its own.
approach_summary: Analyzed 12 months of AP and P-card data across 10 categories ($19M spend, $13.7M addressable) to pinpoint high-impact opportunities.
Renegotiated the must-keep Athenahealth RCM contract—securing a 12.8% fee cut and $259K annual savings despite a $9M early-termination penalty.
Ran competitive RFPs and distributor consolidation that shifted all clinics to a single McKesson formulary, delivering 10.4% savings on medical supplies and eliminating stock-out risk.
Executed make-vs-buy analysis that moved sonography from an outsourced pay-per-scan model to an in-house staffing solution, trimming imaging costs by 18.6%.
Implemented quick-win policy changes—minimum 5-unit IUD orders and Bayer “Confidence in Coverage” enrollment—capturing discounts within 45 days of kickoff.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya has already locked in $684,936 of hard P&L savings, with another $95,337 in late-stage negotiations—totaling $780,273 versus a $450,000 guarantee and dwarfing the $225,000 project fee by 3.4x. Beyond the dollars, Advantia now operates with standardized purchasing policies, a single medical-supply distributor, and clear visibility into category-level spend and contracts—laying the groundwork for sustained margin expansion.
where_we_were_unique: Generated first realized savings within 45 days through low-friction policy changes and manufacturer programs.
Navigated complex clinical and contractual constraints to win retroactive pricing from an entrenched EMR/RCM vendor—something the client deemed ‘impossible’.
Blended sourcing expertise with operational redesign to convert outsourced sonography into a higher-quality, lower-cost insourced model.
Exceeded the private-equity savings guarantee by 52% while simultaneously establishing the client’s first enterprise-wide procurement controls.

generation_notes: Savings figures use finalized + in-progress amounts ($780,273) from close-out and update decks.
ROI calculated as total savings ÷ fixed fee ($780,273 ÷ $225,000 ≈ 3.47).
Approach bullets selected based on categories contributing >80% of total savings.
Uniqueness points reference speed to value, contractual complexity and operational scope.
